newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, eyes on cargo market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, eyes on cargo market.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were steady from Wednesday with traders at the sidelines, seeking direction from the cargo market, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst was indicated at $121-$123 per tonne and 180-cst at $126-$129 per tonne, unchanged from Wedensday.
Traders said quotes were mostly notional as shipowners were anticipating lower prices. Sellers were cautious, hoping to raise prices if cargo levels move up.
MDO and gas oil prices were lower at $238-$242 and $248-$255 per tonne respectively.
